app_documentation:
Simple Task Manager is a web-based task management application designed to help individual users organize and track their daily work items efficiently. Built with modern web technologies including React for the frontend and Node.js/Express with PostgreSQL for the backend, the application provides a clean, intuitive interface for managing personal tasks. The platform enables users to create tasks with titles and optional descriptions, mark them as complete with timestamp tracking, and permanently delete tasks they no longer need. The application features a card-based layout with visual distinction between completed and incomplete tasks, making it easy for users to monitor their progress at a glance.

The primary purpose of Simple Task Manager is to provide a straightforward, distraction-free environment for personal productivity tracking without the complexity of enterprise project management tools. Users can view all their tasks in an organized list sorted by creation date, filter tasks by completion status to focus on pending items, and access a dedicated completed tasks screen to review their accomplishments. The application is optimized for individual users who need a reliable system to capture work items, track progress, and maintain visibility into both active and completed tasks. With features like confirmation dialogs for deletions, task statistics on the user profile, and responsive design for mobile and desktop access, Simple Task Manager balances simplicity with essential functionality.

The application's main features include high-priority capabilities such as task creation with validation (requiring titles while descriptions remain optional), task completion with automatic timestamp recording, and a comprehensive task list view with filtering options. Medium-priority features include task deletion with confirmation dialogs to prevent accidental removal. The user interface follows modern design principles with a primary color scheme of indigo (#4F46E5), success green for completed items, and clear visual hierarchy using the Inter font family. The bottom navigation pattern provides easy access to the main task list, completed tasks view, and user profile sections. All interactive elements meet accessibility standards with proper touch targets, color contrast ratios, and screen reader support, ensuring the application is usable by a wide range of users across different devices and abilities.

glossary.Task: A work item created by a user containing a required title and optional description, tracked with creation timestamp, completion status, and completion timestamp when marked as done.
glossary.FAB (Floating Action Button): A circular button positioned in the bottom-right corner of the Task List screen that opens the Create Task modal when tapped, following mobile design patterns for primary actions.
glossary.Completion Status: A boolean flag (is_completed) indicating whether a task has been marked as complete, used for filtering and visual distinction in the task list, with an associated timestamp (completed_at) recording when the task was completed.
glossary.Bottom Navigation: A fixed navigation bar at the bottom of the screen containing three items (Tasks, Completed, Profile) that allows users to switch between main application sections, with the active item highlighted in the primary color.
glossary.Task Card: A white, rounded rectangular component displaying task information including title, description, creation timestamp, and interactive elements like checkboxes and action buttons, with subtle shadows and borders for visual separation.
glossary.Modal Dialog: An overlay interface component that appears centered on screen with a semi-transparent backdrop, used for focused interactions like creating tasks or confirming deletions, dismissible by tapping outside or using close buttons.
